description: In combination with `histSST`, quantifies the transient effective radiative forcing (ERF), composition and air quality changes from fire emissions over the historical period. Same as `histSST`, except short-lived climate forcer emissions from fires are held at 1850 values. Models with interactive fire should prescribe monthly fire emissions from multiple decades of `piControl` (not a repeating climatology). Atmosphere-only counterpart of `hist-piFire`.
branch_information: Branch from `piControl` at a time of your choosing
